headline: Five reasons to stop.
subline: Checked before every follow-up, and saved on the contact in HubSpot.

cards.title: Replied
cards.quote: Instantly stops the sequence, and the next run marks the contact <u>Replied</u>.

cards.title: Meeting booked
cards.quote: A meeting on the contact ends the follow-ups.

cards.title: Deal open
cards.quote: An open deal means sales has it. <u>No more emails.</u>

cards.title: Unsubscribed
cards.quote: Never emailed again, whatever the count.
